第28章 林美丽议亲-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

腊月初三那天，林海柱托人带话，说腊月初六家里有事，让所有儿女都回老宅。

带话的人是村里的李大叔，跟林海柱是几十年的老交情。

他专门跑到店里来，坐在板凳上喝了一碗面汤，抹着嘴说：“国强，你爹说了，初六务必回去，有大事商量。

你大哥老三那边也通知了，全家都得回去。”

“啥大事？”林国强问。

李大叔摇了摇头：“你爹没说，但看他那样子，像是喜事。

笑眯眯的，嘴上合不拢。”

林国强心里咯噔了一下。

喜事？

上一世，腊月里确实有一件“喜事”。

有人给林美丽说媒，男方姓王，在镇上有头有脸。

当时李红霞高兴得不行，觉得闺女嫁了个好人家，逢人就夸女婿家有钱有势。

林美丽自己也满意，嫁过去的时候风风光光的，穿红戴绿，陪嫁了好几样家具。

结果呢？

嫁过去不到一年，林美丽就被打得跑回娘家，脸上青一块紫一块，胳膊上全是淤青。

王超喝了酒就打人，不喝酒也打，打完了又跪下来求饶，求完了再打。

林国强当时替妹妹出了头，找到王超家，一拳打掉了人家两颗门牙，逼着签了离婚协议。

但那时候林美丽已经被打怕了，整个人瘦得脱了相，眼神都是散的，好久才缓过来。

这一世，又要来了？

“国强？想啥呢？”李大叔喊了他一声。

“哦，没事。”林国强回过神来，“李大叔，谢谢您跑一趟，初六我一定回去。”

李大叔走了之后，赵素梅从后面出来，脸上的表情带着好奇。

“国强，你说会不会是商量美丽的婚事……”

“你也猜到了？”

赵素梅点了点头：“美丽今年十九了，也到了说亲的年纪。

妈一直想把她嫁到镇上去，觉得在镇上吃公粮体面。”

林国强沉默了一会儿，说：“到时候看吧，如果对方人品不行，我劝两句。

他们听不听，是他们的事。”

赵素梅看了他一眼，欲言又止。

她想说“你劝了他们也未必听，别又闹得不愉快”，但她没说出口。

On the third day of the twelfth lunar month, Lin Haizhu asked someone to bring a message, saying that there was something going on at home on the sixth day of the twelfth lunar month and that all his children should return to their old home.

The person who brought the message was Uncle Li from the village, and he had been friends with Lin Haizhu for decades.

He specially came to the store, sat on the bench and drank a bowl of noodle soup, wiping his mouth and said: "Guoqiang, your father said that you must go back on the sixth day of the lunar month. We have important matters to discuss.

Your eldest brother and third brother have also informed you that the whole family must go back."

"What's the big deal?" Lin Guoqiang asked.

Uncle Li shook his head: "Your father didn't say anything, but looking at him like that, it seems like a happy event.

He was smiling widely, his mouth couldn't be closed from ear to ear."

Lin Guoqiang's heart skipped a beat.

happy event?

In the last life, there was indeed a "happy event" in the twelfth lunar month.

Someone arranged a match for Lin Meili. The man's surname was Wang and he was well-known in the town.

At that time, Li Hongxia was extremely happy. She felt that her daughter had married into a good family, and she always praised her son-in-law's family for being rich and powerful.

Lin Meili herself was also satisfied. When she got married, she looked glamorous, dressed in red and green, and came with several pieces of furniture.

The result?

Less than a year after getting married, Lin Meili was beaten until she ran back to her parents' home. Her face was bruised and her arms were covered in bruises.

Wang Chao would beat people when he was drinking, and he would beat people when he was not drinking. After the beating, he would kneel down and beg for mercy, and then beat him again after he had finished begging.

Lin Guoqiang stood up for his sister at that time, went to Wang Chao's house, knocked out two front teeth with one punch, and forced him to sign a divorce agreement.

But at that time, Lin Meili was already frightened. She was so thin that she lost her appearance, and her eyes were blurry. It took a long time for her to recover.

Is this life coming again?

"Guoqiang? What are you thinking about?" Uncle Li called him.

"Oh, it's okay." Lin Guoqiang came to his senses and said, "Uncle Li, thank you for your trip. I will definitely go back on the sixth day of the Lunar New Year."

After Uncle Li left, Zhao Sumei came out from behind with a curious expression on her face.

"Guoqiang, are you talking about a beautiful marriage..."

"Did you guess it too?"

Zhao Sumei nodded: "Meili is nineteen this year, and she has reached the age to propose marriage.

Mom always wanted to marry her to the town, as she thought it would be decent to eat public food in the town."

Lin Guoqiang was silent for a while and said: "We will see when the time comes. If the other party's character is not good, I will give you a few words of advice.

Whether they listen or not is their business."

Zhao Sumei glanced at him and hesitated to speak.

She wanted to say, "They may not listen even if you try to persuade them, so don't make it unpleasant again," but she didn't say it.
